newsletter.markdown:
1. **Discovery & Translational Science** — targets, mechanisms, biomarkers, preclinical and translational research, and reviews of the science.

- **The evolving landscape of drug targets** [Nature Reviews Drug Discovery](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41573-026-01530-3)
  - A 25-year review maps the expansion of the therapeutic target landscape, noting that drugs now mediate their effects across ~700 distinct biomolecules driven by genomics, automation, and new modalities.

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II** — first-in-human, dose-finding, and proof-of-concept studies; anything explicitly Phase 1/2 or early-to-mid stage.

- **[Biotech]** **Alkermes reports Phase 1b ADHD results** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/21/alkermes-orexin-agonist-adhd-study/?utm_campaign=rss)
  - Alkermes announced that its oral orexin agonist candidate showed clinical proof-of-concept and therapeutic potential for adults with ADHD in an early-stage study.
- **[Biotech]** **Tls Therapeutics completes Phase 2a INFORM-MS trial** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2101991210906796503)
  - Tls Therapeutics announced that the last patient completed their final visit in the Phase 2a INFORM-MS trial evaluating intranasal foralumab, with topline data expected in October.

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III** — pivotal/registrational trials and practice-changing efficacy or safety readouts; Phase 3, large RCTs, major journal (NEJM/Lancet/JAMA) results.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Novo Nordisk reports REIMAGINE 5 trial results for CagriSema** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2101990238167986279)
  - CagriSema (1.0 mg/1.0 mg) achieved superior weight loss of 12.4% versus tirzepatide 5 mg at 9.1%, alongside non-inferior HbA1c reduction at week 60 in adults with type 2 diabetes.

4. **Regulatory & Approvals** — FDA/EMA actions: approvals, complete response letters, label or safety changes, NDA/BLA filings and acceptances, advisory-committee votes.

- **FDA updates regulations on alternative testing methods** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-updates-regulations-advance-innovative-alternatives-animal-testing)
  - Issued a direct final rule clarifying that non-animal methods—including human cells, organs-on-chips, and computer models—can be used where appropriate for preclinical human drug safety testing.
- **[Big Pharma]** **Insmed secures FDA priority review for Arikayce sNDA** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2101990869045813682)
  - The FDA granted priority review to the supplemental New Drug Application for Arikayce for the treatment of Mycobacterium avium complex (MAC) lung disease, with a PDUFA target date of January 28, 2027.

5. **Business & Strategy** — deals, licensing, M&A, financings, legal disputes, and pipeline reprioritization (program starts, halts, discontinuations).

- **[Biotech]** **Telix to acquire ITM Isotope Technologies Munich** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/telix-itm-radiopharmaceuticals-deal-acquire-lutetium-novartis/830859/)
  - Telix Pharmaceuticals entered an agreement to acquire German radiopharmaceuticals developer ITM for $1.65 billion upfront plus up to $700 million in milestones, creating a combined radiotherapeutic and diagnostic powerhouse.
- **[Big Pharma]** **Novo Nordisk partners with Orbis Medicines** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2101719301455487063)
  - Signed a discovery and licensing agreement worth up to $1.4 billion to develop novel oral therapies for cardiometabolic diseases.
- **[Biotech]** **ADARx Pharma sets IPO valuation target** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2101998180405551398)
  - ADARx Pharma is targeting a $1.74 billion valuation for its upcoming U.S. initial public offering.

6. **Public Health & Policy** — outbreaks, vaccination and access, research ethics and oversight, health policy.

- **The BMJ criticized over COVID-19 vaccine safety reporting** [Science-Based Medicine](https://sciencebasedmedicine.org/the-bmj-once-again-wittingly-or-unwittingly-reinforces-a-antivax-narrative/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=the-bmj-once-again-wittingly-or-unwittingly-reinforces-a-antivax-narrative)
  - Observers criticized a recent BMJ investigation alleging algorithmic flaws in post-vaccination safety signal surveillance, noting it amplifies established anti-vaccine narratives.
- **Global consensus guidelines issued for personalized bacteriophage therapy** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04654-6)
  - Published consensus-based guidelines outlining practice-oriented recommendations for the safe, standardized clinical deployment of personalized phage therapies.

**Worth watching** — Monitor upcoming October topline data for intranasal foralumab in Phase 2a multiple sclerosis, and follow the integration trajectory of Telix and ITM following their major radiopharma consolidation move.

youtube.markdown:
- Biology & Health
    - [The Mortality Effect of Walnuts are Hard to Ignore - Why?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K9OJ2JlfGIk) -- Physionic
        - Analyzes the effects of walnut consumption on cardiovascular markers, specifically looking at changes in lipoprotein subclasses, fasting non-HDL cholesterol, and apolipoprotein B (ApoB).
        - Explores how a walnut-enriched diet impacts endothelial function, postprandial lipemia, oxidative stress, and cholesterol efflux in both healthy and hypercholesterolemic populations.
        - Investigates the relationship between walnuts and systemic inflammation, highlighting shifts in eicosanoids, cytokines, soluble endothelial adhesion molecules, and serum oxylipin profiles.
        - Evaluates the effect of dietary walnuts on the gastrointestinal microbiota and microbially derived secondary bile acids.
    - [Thyroid health: interpreting symptoms, diagnosing & treating dysfunction, & navigating the gray zone](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6Bhq-PBWG8c) -- Peter Attia MD
        - Discusses the biological mechanisms of the thyroid gland, the functions of free T4, free T3, and TSH, the conversion process of T4 into the active T3 hormone, and the utility of measuring reverse T3.
        - Addresses the diagnostic complexities of thyroid health, explaining why clinical symptoms alone are insufficient for diagnosis and analyzing the limitations of standard thyroid blood test assays.
        - Outlines strategies for managing hypothyroidism, including navigating subclinical hypothyroidism, treating patients with T4 and T3 medications, and optimizing absorption through correct drug administration.
        - Covers related clinical topics such as Hashimoto's disease, pregnancy considerations, hyperthyroidism risks, the potential dangers of excess iodine, and the efficacy of thyroid-support supplements.
    - [Can AI Regulation Keep Up With AI?](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Y_nwdIrfi0s) -- Health2Tech
        - Features Ashley Cairns discussing the core difficulties regulators face when trying to keep pace with the rapid development of artificial intelligence.
        - Highlights the mounting tension and policy misalignment between federal-level frameworks and state-specific AI regulations.
        - Examines the broader landscape of AI policy and the ongoing friction within technology regulation.
- Tech & Engineering
    - [Un chasseur de bots nous dévoile les ruses des fraudeurs](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ch8J7uVEddc) -- Underscore_
        - Explores how highly sophisticated web security systems are being bypassed and defeated by teenagers as young as 16 years old.
        - Features a panel discussion with hosts and experts, including Antoine Vastel, Tiffany Souterre, and Michaël de Marliave, to uncover the methods and ruses used by online fraudsters and bots.
        - Discusses educational opportunities in technical security and software development, highlighting a partnership with Holberton School.
- To watch
